text:
michael: pushed fixes to PR #4923 — addressed the review notes about the KV cache guard and the route fallback. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4923
sophia: thanks. quick question — does the new guard change behavior when the prefix is empty? could use a tiny unit to cover that case
michael: good catch, i added a test in cache_test.go: `assert.Equal(t, "", entry.Prefix)` and kept the old no-op path for empty prefixes
raj: skimmed the diff. code looks safe. please add a one-line changelog entry and bump the go.mod minor so releases pick it up
michael: added CHANGELOG entry and bumped module to v0.12.1 in the same branch
jen: re-running CI now — one flaky windows integration test failed earlier, so i'm kicking off a rerun (:spinner:)
ci-bot: CI job #4923 started — linux, macos, windows
ci-bot: linux job succeeded
ci-bot: macos job succeeded
ci-bot: windows job failed — `windows_integration_test` timeout; rerunning
sophia: also could you leave a short inline comment explaining why nil kvs are safe here? saved reviewer time
michael: added inline comment above the guard: `// nil-kv can appear during cold-start; treat as empty cache` and pushed
raj: i can approve after the windows job passes. looks fine and tests + changelog present :thumbsup:
jen: windows passed on rerun — all green now
raj: Approved. :shipit:
michael: thanks y'all — planning to merge in ~5m so canary includes this for tomorrow's rollout. ping if you need me to hold off
sophia: all good from me :eyes:
michael: merging now. thanks! :pray:
